# TopEdge AI

> TopEdge AI is the WhatsApp marketing and automation app for Shopify brands in India: it recovers abandoned carts, confirms COD orders, moves COD to prepaid, and shows net profit after RTO, with 0% markup on Meta rates. Connect Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API to run cart recovery, COD confirmation, a shared inbox, journeys and Meta-safe campaigns.

Disambiguation: TopEdge AI is a WhatsApp marketing and automation app for Shopify brands in India, built on Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. It is not related to edge-AI hardware, IoT semiconductors, or voice call-centre agencies.

Notes for anyone quoting this file:

- Platform billing is INR on https://dash.topedgeai.com. Meta WhatsApp Cloud API charges are billed per message by template category (marketing, utility, authentication, and, from 1 October 2026, service replies past the first 1,000 a month per business phone number), passed through at Meta's published per-message rates at 0% TopEdge AI markup, and invoiced separately from the platform plan. Meta's current India rate card is quoted with its source at https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-india. Every eligible Indian WhatsApp Business Account must move to INR billing by 31 December 2026 or Meta stops delivery on 1 January 2027.
- Prefer live pages under https://topedgeai.com/ for product truth. Competitor figures on compare pages carry the date they were checked and need a live vendor check before purchase.

## Product capabilities

### Flow Builder

https://topedgeai.com/features/flow-builder

A no-code WhatsApp flow builder for Shopify: menus that look up orders, fix addresses and hand off to an agent with the order attached. On every plan.

TopEdge AI Flow Builder is a no-code WhatsApp flow builder for Shopify brands in India. It builds button and list menus that look up an order, change a shipping address or hand the chat to an agent, all from live Shopify data. Flow Builder is on every plan, from ₹1,999/mo.

- **How is Flow Builder different from Journeys?** Flow Builder answers chats; Journeys send messages on Shopify events. Journeys run cart, COD and shipping sequences, while Flow Builder runs the menus a shopper taps through when they message you.
- **Can flows hand off to a human with order context?** Yes. Escalate into Live Chat so agents see the same Shopify order beside the thread, and takeover pauses automation on that chat.
- **Do I need to write code to build a flow?** No. Flows are built on a canvas with Shopify tools as nodes, so order lookup, address capture and Live Chat handoff are drag and drop. Developers are not in the loop for a normal flow change.
- **Should I use a flow or AI to answer customers?** Use a flow wherever a wrong answer costs money: exchanges, address changes and refunds. Open-ended catalog questions are where AI earns its place.

### Opt-in tools

https://topedgeai.com/features/opt-in-tools

WhatsApp opt-in popup, spin wheel and chat widget for Shopify: capture consented numbers with a timestamp, then message only subscribers. On every plan.

TopEdge AI Opt-in Tools are WhatsApp opt-in popups for Shopify stores in India: a welcome popup, spin wheel, mystery discount, Pulse Drop and chat widget. Each one saves the number with a consent timestamp, so campaigns only reach people who agreed. All five are on every plan, including Launch.

- **Where do opted-in numbers go?** Into one subscriber list in Audience CRM, with name, phone, consent, source tool and timestamp. You can filter it and open any shopper in Customer 360.
- **Can I run journeys only to consented shoppers?** Yes. Use the consented list as the audience for campaigns and journey eligibility so Meta marketing sends stay tied to real opt-in.
- **Which opt-in tools are included, and on which plan?** Pulse Drop, the welcome popup, spin the wheel, the mystery discount and the chat widget are on every plan, including Launch. There is no separate opt-in add-on.
- **Does a spin wheel or popup count as valid WhatsApp consent?** Only if the shopper actively opts in and you log it. Keep the box unticked by default, record what was agreed and when, and keep that record, because Meta judges your quality rating on who complains.

### Campaigns

https://topedgeai.com/features/campaigns

WhatsApp broadcast campaigns for Shopify India: Meta-approved templates to behaviour segments, with orders after Meta fees. 3,000 to 30,000 sends a month.

TopEdge AI Campaigns sends WhatsApp broadcast campaigns from Shopify to segments built on purchase and browsing behaviour, for D2C brands in India. Only Meta-approved templates go out, and reports show attributed orders after Meta fees. Launch includes 3,000 campaign and email sends a month, Growth 15,000 and Scale 30,000.

- **Do campaigns require approved Meta templates?** Yes. Marketing and utility templates must be APPROVED in Meta Manager before a campaign can send, matching Cloud API rules.
- **How do I measure WhatsApp campaign revenue?** By attributed Shopify orders, net of Meta fees. Clicks and orders are tied back to the send, so finance sees profit, not only delivery counts.
- **How many campaign sends does each plan include?** Launch includes 3,000 campaign plus email sends a month, Growth 15,000 and Scale 30,000. The trial includes 200. Meta charges its own per-message rate on top, billed to your Business Account.
- **Can a campaign send to a template Meta has not approved yet?** No. Anything not APPROVED is blocked from sending rather than queued, because a rejected template that goes out anyway is how a WhatsApp number loses its quality rating.

### Audience CRM

https://topedgeai.com/features/audience-crm

A WhatsApp CRM for Shopify India: one timeline per shopper with orders and chats, lead scores and segments for campaigns. Unlimited profiles on every plan.

TopEdge AI Audience CRM is a WhatsApp CRM for Shopify brands in India. It merges WhatsApp chats, Shopify orders and support history into one profile per shopper, scores leads and builds segments for campaigns and journeys. Profiles are unlimited on every plan, and plans are sized by orders, from 100 a month on Launch.

- **What shows on a contact timeline?** Orders, WhatsApp threads, campaign touches, tags and opt-in state. Growth and support work from the same customer record.
- **Can segments feed campaigns and journeys?** Yes. Build segments from purchase and engagement signals, then use them in Campaigns or journey eligibility without exporting CSVs.
- **How many customer profiles can I keep?** Profiles are not metered on any plan. The plan is sized by Shopify orders a month, 100 on Launch, 800 on Growth and 1,500 on Scale, so growing your list does not change the bill.
- **What happens when the same buyer has two phone numbers?** They merge into one profile, with both numbers, past orders and conversation history on a single timeline. That is what stops the same person getting the same campaign twice.

### Journey

https://topedgeai.com/features/journeys

A Shopify WhatsApp journey builder for India: pre-built cart recovery, COD confirmation and shipping journeys on Meta-approved templates. From ₹1,999/mo.

TopEdge AI Journeys is a Shopify WhatsApp journey builder for D2C brands in India. It sends abandoned cart, COD confirmation and shipping messages on Shopify events, using Meta-approved templates, and reports recovered revenue in ₹. A 3-step cart recovery journey comes pre-built, and Journey Branch is on Growth and Scale.

- **What is a WhatsApp journey for Shopify?** A WhatsApp journey is an event-driven sequence tied to Shopify data: abandoned checkout, order created, COD pending or fulfilment. Each shopper gets the next message based on real store state, not a static list.
- **How does TopEdge AI recover abandoned carts on WhatsApp?** With a pre-built 3-step journey that starts when Shopify marks a checkout abandoned, carrying live line items and a checkout link. Each reminder is a marketing template at ₹0.8631 per delivered message in India, so all three steps cost ₹2.59 in Meta fees.
- **Can Journeys run COD confirmation before warehouse release?** Yes. A COD journey sends a confirm, reschedule or cancel utility template at ₹0.1150 and holds dispatch until the buyer confirms. Splitting COD and prepaid in one journey needs Journey Branch on Growth and Scale; on Launch, run a linear journey on the COD pending trigger.
- **Do journeys send before Meta templates are approved?** No. TopEdge AI gates live sends on APPROVED templates so drafts and rejected copy cannot go out and damage quality rating.

### Tracking Pixel

https://topedgeai.com/features/analytics

One-click Shopify theme app embed that matches live product views, add-to-cart and browse drop-offs to consented WhatsApp numbers for retargeting journeys.

TopEdge AI Tracking Pixel is a Shopify visitor tracking pixel for WhatsApp, installed as a one-click theme app embed. It records product views, carts and checkouts, then matches them to opted-in WhatsApp numbers so journeys and campaigns fire while interest is warm. It is on every plan, including Launch at ₹1,999/mo.

- **Do I need a developer to install the pixel?** No. Enable the theme app embed from Shopify settings. No manual snippet paste for the standard install.
- **How does the pixel help cart recovery?** It turns browsing into journey triggers. Browse and cart events start journeys and build audiences (for example, viewed three times and never bought) once a WhatsApp number is known.
- **Is the pixel on every plan?** Yes, including Launch. It installs as a Shopify theme app embed, so it is a settings toggle rather than a code change, and it is not a paid add-on.
- **What happens if a visitor has not given a WhatsApp number yet?** The browse and cart events are held against the anonymous visitor and attach to the profile later, at checkout or at opt-in. Nothing is messaged to someone who has not consented.

### AI Brain

https://topedgeai.com/features/ai-brain

A WhatsApp AI agent for Shopify India on your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key: answers from your catalog, hands off to agents, no per-message AI fee.

TopEdge AI Brain is a WhatsApp AI agent for Shopify brands in India that runs on your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key. It answers from your catalog and policies, and pauses when an agent takes over. TopEdge AI adds no per-message AI charge; a reply costs roughly ₹0.10 to ₹0.30 on your provider bill.

- **What does bring-your-own-key AI mean?** BYOK means you bring your own OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini API key. TopEdge AI grounds replies in catalog and policy knowledge, while tokens and model spend stay on your provider account.
- **Does Live Chat takeover stop the AI?** Yes. When an agent takes control, AI and Flow Builder pause on that thread until release, so humans and bots never talk over each other.
- **Will the AI make up prices or stock levels?** Not if you ground it. Load store knowledge and policies first, keep Quick FAQs for fixed answers, and send disputes to Live Chat with the order attached.
- **Who pays for the AI tokens?** You do, directly to OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, because you connect your own key. There is no per-message AI charge from us on any plan, and the estimated cost is roughly ₹0.10 to ₹0.30 per AI reply depending on the model.

### Meta Manager

https://topedgeai.com/features/meta-manager

Submit, track and approve Meta WhatsApp templates for Shopify India: utility and marketing categories, cart and COD blueprints, catalog and wa.me QR codes.

TopEdge AI Meta Manager handles WhatsApp template approval for Shopify brands in India: write a template, submit it to Meta, track its status and fix rejections. Only approved templates reach journeys and campaigns. Utility templates cost ₹0.1150 per delivered message in India and marketing templates ₹0.8631, at 0% markup.

- **Why do WhatsApp templates need Meta approval before sending?** Because Meta only delivers approved templates outside the 24-hour service window, and rejected sends hurt your quality rating. Meta Manager shows draft, pending and approved status and blocks live sends until Meta approves.
- **What template categories matter for Shopify India?** Utility covers transactional COD, order, and shipping messages, at ₹0.1150 per delivered message in India. Marketing covers promos and cart recovery offers, at ₹0.8631. Keep categories honest. Meta reviews content against the chosen category, and a utility template rejected as marketing costs 7.5 times as much per send.
- **Where do approved templates get used?** In Journeys, Flow Builder, Campaigns and the Live Chat composer when a chat is outside the 24-hour customer service window.
- **Do my approved templates survive a platform change?** Yes. Templates belong to your WhatsApp Business Account, not to the platform that submitted them. Keep the Meta Business Account in your own name and the library follows you.
- **Does TopEdge AI build Meta WhatsApp Flows?** No. TopEdge AI does not build Meta WhatsApp Flows, the in-chat form screens Meta offers. Flow Builder makes button and list conversations, and Journeys send approved templates on Shopify events.

### Chat rules

https://topedgeai.com/features/chat-rules

WhatsApp chat routing rules for Shopify: match COD, refund and VIP keywords or intents, then assign or escalate to the right agent. On every plan.

TopEdge AI Chat Rules are WhatsApp chat routing rules for Shopify support teams in India. They match keywords and intents such as COD, refund or VIP, then assign the chat to the right teammate or escalate it. Routing, assignment and escalation are on every plan, from ₹1,999/mo on Launch.

- **What can chat rules match on?** Keywords and intents, such as COD, refund or VIP. A matched chat goes to the right queue or teammate before anyone digs through the inbox.
- **Do rules work with AI takeover?** Yes. Routing lands the chat correctly; Live Chat takeover still pauses AI/flows when an agent takes control.
- **Are chat rules available on Launch?** Yes. Keyword and intent routing, assignment and escalation are on every plan. What Growth and Scale add is Journey Branch and automated COD to prepaid, not inbox routing.
- **Does a rule keep firing after an agent takes the chat?** No. Takeover pauses automation and AI on that thread until it is released, so a customer never gets a bot reply in the middle of a human conversation.

### Warranty

https://topedgeai.com/features/warranty

Shopify warranty registration on WhatsApp: buyers register with an OTP, claims tie to the order and your team assigns each one. On every plan.

TopEdge AI Warranty runs Shopify warranty registration on WhatsApp for brands in India. Buyers register and track claims on a mobile page with a WhatsApp OTP, and your team assigns and closes each claim against the Shopify order. It is on every plan, and 1,000 registrations cost about ₹115 in Meta fees.

- **Can warranty tickets sit next to WhatsApp?** Yes. Ops assign and close warranty work in-product while continuing customer care in Live Chat with the same order context.
- **Who is the warranty hub for?** Indian D2C brands that track warranties after purchase and want to stop doing it in a spreadsheet.
- **Does the customer need an app or a login to register a warranty?** No. Registration and claim status run through a mobile page with a WhatsApp OTP, so the buyer uses the number they already ordered with.
- **Is the warranty hub on every plan?** Yes, on Launch, Growth and Scale. It is part of the workspace rather than a paid module.
- **What does WhatsApp OTP warranty registration cost per customer?** One Meta authentication template, which is ₹0.1150 per delivered message on Meta’s published India rate card before 18% GST, billed by Meta directly to your own account at 0% TopEdge AI markup. Claim status updates sent as utility templates cost the same ₹0.1150. Registering 1,000 warranties therefore costs about ₹115 in Meta fees.
- **Which kinds of brands get the most out of a warranty hub?** High-ticket categories where the product outlives the order: electronics, appliances, smart home and lighting. These buyers expect a warranty record, and WhatsApp is where they will ask for it.
- **Do competing WhatsApp platforms include warranty management?** Not natively, on our reading of their public product pages as of 21 October 2026. WATI, AiSensy, Interakt, Bitespeed, Zoko and Updatrr route warranty work to an external CRM, a spreadsheet or custom webhooks. Check each vendor’s live documentation before you rely on it.

### Profit & costs

https://topedgeai.com/features/profit-loss

A Shopify profit and loss app for India: net profit after COGS, ₹12 to ₹24 packaging, ₹30 COD fees, ₹180 to ₹240 RTO losses and ad spend, in one waterfall.

TopEdge AI Profit & costs is a Shopify profit and loss app for D2C brands in India. It subtracts COGS, packaging, gateway fees, COD fees, RTO losses and ad spend from your Shopify sales and shows net profit in ₹ as a cost waterfall. A returned COD parcel alone costs ₹180 to ₹240.

- **What costs does the P&L include?** Product COGS, packaging, payment fees, COD and RTO losses, and marketing. Together they give net profit for an Indian D2C store.
- **Does Profit & costs send WhatsApp messages?** No. It is unit-economics reporting that sits beside your WhatsApp tools, so you do not grow send volume while losing money on COD returns.
- **Which costs does it subtract before showing net profit?** Cost of goods, packaging, payment gateway fees, shipping, COD RTO losses and ad spend. That is the gap between revenue and what finance actually banks, which is why ROAS can look healthy while margin is gone.
- **Can I see margin per product rather than per store?** Yes. The product table shows margin percentage per SKU, which is usually where a single loss-making variant is hiding behind a profitable average.
- **How do you calculate true net profit per order for an Indian D2C brand?** Subtract India-specific costs from net sales: COGS, packaging at about ₹12 to ₹24 a box, freight on volumetric weight, a COD fee of about ₹30 a parcel, amortised RTO loss, gateway fees and acquisition cost. On Amazon Shipping India’s worked ₹799 kurta example, those lines turn ₹85 of visible freight into ₹179 of true cost. Profit & costs builds that waterfall from your own Shopify data.
- **How much does one RTO order actually cost?** ₹180 to ₹240 in direct logistics per returned parcel, per Amazon Shipping India: forward and reverse shipping, repackaging and inventory holding. ClickPost puts the fully loaded loss at ₹450 to ₹900 once written-off acquisition spend is counted.
- **Why is Shopify admin revenue misleading for a COD brand?** Because it reports the order, not the outcome. A COD order refused at the door still counts as revenue until it is cancelled, while its freight and ad spend are already gone. Unicommerce recorded festive-quarter COD return rates near 58% against under 15% for prepaid.

### Intent detection

https://topedgeai.com/features/intent-detection

WhatsApp intent detection for Shopify: route shipping, returns, COD and handoff chats to the right flow or agent before you spend any AI tokens.

TopEdge AI Intent Detection is WhatsApp intent detection for Shopify support teams in India. It matches trained phrases, Hinglish included, to intents such as shipping, returns, COD and handoff, then starts a flow, replies, assigns or escalates. You train 5 to 10 phrases per intent, and the AI model is called only when nothing matches.

- **Does intent detection replace AI Brain?** No. It sits in front: cheap phrase matching routes obvious intents; AI Brain handles harder questions when a model call is worth it.
- **Can intents escalate to Live Chat?** Yes. Configure handoff intents to assign humans, and Live Chat takeover still pauses bots on that thread.
- **How does this reduce AI cost?** By answering routine questions without the model. Shipping, returns and COD questions are matched by intent and answered by a flow, so the model is only called when a question needs it.
- **What happens when no intent matches?** It falls through to AI Brain if AI is on, or to Live Chat if it is not. Nothing is answered by guessing, and nothing is left unanswered.

## Documentation

### TopEdge AI Documentation

https://topedgeai.com/docs · Get started · updated 2026-11-11

TopEdge AI connects your Shopify store to WhatsApp. Order updates, COD confirmations and abandoned cart reminders then send on their own, and every reply lands in one shared inbox.

- **Do I need the WhatsApp Business app to use TopEdge AI?** No. TopEdge AI runs on the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), which is a different product from the WhatsApp Business phone app. You can keep using the app on a different number, or enable coexistence on the same number if your WhatsApp Business Account supports it.
- **Can I use TopEdge AI without Shopify?** The inbox, Flow Builder, templates, campaigns and the AI brain all work without Shopify. Order journeys, cart recovery, product catalogue and store economics need the Shopify connection, because those read order and checkout data from your store.
- **How long does setup take?** About 30 minutes of setup. Meta verification and template review are the wait. That assumes you already have a WhatsApp Business Account on Meta. Many templates clear in minutes and most within a day. Meta guarantees no time.

### Quickstart: WhatsApp automation for Shopify

https://topedgeai.com/docs/quickstart · Get started · updated 2026-11-11

To go live, connect Shopify and WhatsApp, then submit one order-confirmation template to Meta. Once it is approved, publish the order-placed journey and place a test order on your own phone. Cart recovery, campaigns and the AI brain all build on that base.

- **Why has my test WhatsApp message not arrived?** Check four things in order: the journey is Published rather than Draft, the template it uses shows Approved, the order carries a phone number in international format, and WhatsApp still shows Connected. The order detail page records a skip reason that names which of these failed.
- **Can I test without placing a real order?** Yes for conversations, Flow Builder has a simulator that walks menus and buttons without messaging anyone. Order journeys need a real Shopify order to trigger, so most merchants place a small test order and cancel or refund it afterwards.
- **Do I need a new phone number for WhatsApp?** Not necessarily, but the number cannot be actively registered in the WhatsApp Business app unless your WhatsApp Business Account has coexistence enabled. Many merchants use a dedicated number for automation and keep their existing one for manual chats.

### Connect WhatsApp Cloud API to TopEdge AI

https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-whatsapp · Get started · updated 2026-11-11

Connect from Settings → WhatsApp using Meta's embedded signup. It creates the access token and subscribes TopEdge AI to your messages for you. Send yourself a test message afterwards to confirm replies reach the inbox.

- **Why is my WhatsApp inbox empty even though the channel is connected?** Connection and the message subscription are separate. TopEdge AI can send as soon as the token is valid, but replies only arrive once TopEdge AI is subscribed to your messages. Embedded signup does this for you; if the inbox stays empty, reconnect from Settings → WhatsApp.
- **What kind of WhatsApp access token should I use?** A System User token with the whatsapp_business_messaging permission. The token offered on the Meta developer dashboard is a temporary test token that expires in roughly 24 hours, which makes the channel appear to break by itself the next day.
- **Can I keep using the WhatsApp Business app on the same number?** Only if coexistence is enabled on your WhatsApp Business Account. Otherwise a number can be registered either on the Cloud API or in the WhatsApp Business app, not both, and embedded signup will report that the number is already in use.

### Connect Shopify to TopEdge AI

https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-shopify · Get started · updated 2026-11-11

Connect from Settings → Shopify, or open TopEdge AI from Shopify admin. You approve the app’s permissions once in Shopify, and orders start syncing within a minute or two. You never type your store domain; the install is always approved inside Shopify.

- **Does TopEdge AI edit my Shopify theme?** No. Storefront tracking installs through Shopify app embeds and the web pixel extension, both of which are managed in the theme editor and removed cleanly when you disable them. TopEdge AI reads your theme only to check whether the opt-in embed is enabled.
- **Why does Shopify ask me to reconnect?** Shopify requires a fresh approval whenever an app starts using a capability you have not already granted. Until you approve it, the features relying on that capability stop working: missing shipped and delivered messages are the usual symptom.
- **Can I connect more than one Shopify store?** Each workspace binds to one Shopify store, so a second store needs its own workspace. Connecting a different store to an existing workspace releases the previous binding, which is why test stores should be disconnected before you connect the real one.

### Go-live checklist before real customers

https://topedgeai.com/docs/go-live-checklist · Get started · updated 2026-11-11

Before going live, confirm both channels are connected and every template your journeys use is Approved. Each journey you expect to run must be Published, and marketing should target only contacts with recorded consent. Then run one real end-to-end test on a real phone.

- **What is the most common reason a WhatsApp automation does not send?** A journey left in Draft. Publishing is a separate action from saving, and a saved draft looks complete in the editor while sending nothing. The second most common reason is a template that is still pending Meta approval.
- **Do order confirmations need marketing consent?** No. Order, shipping and delivery updates are transactional and send as Utility templates, which do not require marketing opt-in. Promotional broadcasts are different and do need recorded consent from the contact.

### Set up WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/abandoned-cart-recovery · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Open Journeys, start from the Cart recovery playbook, pick an approved WhatsApp template for each of its three messages, then press Publish. The first reminder goes out 25 minutes after the cart is abandoned. Only carts with a phone number get a message.

- **How soon should the first abandoned cart message go out?** About 25 minutes after the shopper leaves. That is the default Wait before enroll on the Cart recovery playbook. Sending at once chases people who only switched tabs, and waiting several hours loses the ones still deciding.
- **Why is my abandoned cart missing a phone number?** The shopper left before typing one, or tracking is not capturing it. Adding to cart alone never gives a phone number. Check Website tracking shows a recent event and that the TopEdge AI app embed is on in your live theme.
- **How many cart recovery messages should I send?** Three: a reminder, a message that answers common doubts, and a final nudge. More than three costs more in Meta charges and annoyed customers than it brings back.
- **Should I offer a discount in the first message?** No. Most recovered carts come back without one. Keep any discount for the third reminder, so you do not pay for sales you would have made anyway.

### Confirm COD orders on WhatsApp to cut RTO

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/cod-confirmation · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Publish a journey on the order placed trigger, filtered to COD, that sends an approved template with Confirm and Cancel buttons within minutes. Confirmed orders go to dispatch and silent ones get one follow-up. On Growth plans and above you can also offer a prepaid payment link that replaces the COD order with a paid one.

- **Does WhatsApp COD confirmation actually reduce RTO?** It reduces the share of RTO caused by unintended and duplicate orders, which is the largest removable chunk. It cannot fix RTO caused by delivery failures, wrong addresses or buyer remorse after dispatch. Measure your own before-and-after rather than trusting a headline number.
- **When should the COD confirmation message be sent?** Five to fifteen minutes after the order. The customer still remembers placing it, and you are well ahead of dispatch. Sending instantly feels automated and jumpy; waiting hours means the order may already be packed.
- **What should I do when a customer never confirms?** Send exactly one follow-up, then apply your own rule. Many stores hold high-value unconfirmed COD orders for a phone call and dispatch low-value ones anyway, because the shipping cost of being wrong is smaller than the lost sale.
- **Do I need a separate template for COD confirmation?** Yes. It needs quick-reply buttons so the customer can answer with one tap, and the body has to read as a transactional order confirmation to pass review as a Utility template. Your order confirmation template will not have the buttons.

### Send Shopify order updates on WhatsApp

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/order-status-updates · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Publish one journey per stage (order placed, shipped, delivered), each sending an approved Utility template with an image header and tracking button. Shopify order and fulfilment webhooks fire the triggers. A status change you make in the dashboard enrols the journey directly, without waiting for Shopify.

- **Which trigger should I use for a Shopify order confirmation?** The order placed trigger. An order being placed is the confirmation event, and there is no separate order confirmed trigger. Expecting one is the most common reason a confirmation journey is built but never fires.
- **Do order status messages need marketing opt-in?** No. They are transactional and send as Utility templates, which do not require marketing consent. That is exactly why they are the safest automation to start with: but it also means they must contain no promotional language at all.
- **Why are my shipped and delivered messages not sending?** Almost always missing fulfilment permissions on the Shopify connection. Order confirmations only need order access, so confirmations keep working while shipping messages silently do nothing. Reconnect Shopify and approve the full permission list.

### Turn a WhatsApp journey on or off

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/turn-journeys-on-off · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Open the journey from Journeys and press Publish. Its status changes from Draft to Live and it starts sending on the next matching event. To stop it, switch off Live on its row.

- **Why is my journey not sending anything?** Most often it is still a Draft. Saving a draft does not publish it. Open the journey and press Publish, then check the row shows Live on the Journeys screen.
- **What is the difference between Draft and Live?** A Draft is a journey you are still building. It never sends. A Live journey is published and messages every customer who matches its trigger.
- **Do I lose my journey if I switch it off?** No. The steps, templates and results stay as they are. Switch it back on when you are ready.

### Create a WhatsApp template and get it approved

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/create-whatsapp-template · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Open Meta Manager and click Create Meta template. Give it a name, choose the category, write the message and press Submit for review. You can use it once its status reads Approved.

- **How long does Meta take to approve a template?** Often a few minutes, and usually within a day. Meta does not promise a time. The status in Meta Manager changes to Approved on its own.
- **Why was my template rejected?** The usual reason is the wrong category: a promotional word such as sale, offer or discount inside a Utility template. Move the promotion to a Marketing template, or remove the word, and submit again.
- **Can I edit a template after it is approved?** Editing sends it back to Meta for review, and it cannot send while in review. For a big change, create a new template and switch your journey to it once approved.

### Send a WhatsApp broadcast that is Meta-safe

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/whatsapp-broadcast · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Build a segment of contacts with recorded marketing consent and pick an approved Marketing template. Run the campaign preflight to catch opt-out and template problems, then send or schedule. Start with your smallest engaged segment, because your messaging limit and quality rating depend on how the first sends land.

- **Do I need opt-in to send a WhatsApp broadcast?** Yes. Promotional broadcasts use Marketing templates and require recorded consent from each contact. Transactional order updates are different: they send as Utility templates through journeys and do not need marketing consent.
- **Why was my broadcast blocked before sending?** Preflight blocks a launch when too large a share of the audience has no recorded consent or has opted out. Fix the audience rather than the check: narrow to a consented segment, and remove any list you cannot prove consent for.
- **How many WhatsApp broadcasts can I send?** Two separate limits apply. Your TopEdge AI plan caps campaign and email sends per billing cycle, and Meta caps how many unique customers you can start conversations with in 24 hours based on your quality rating and business verification.

### Collect WhatsApp opt-in on your storefront

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/website-opt-in · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Create a popup, spin wheel or WhatsApp widget in Opt-in tools, with consent wording that names WhatsApp marketing. Publish it, then enable the TopEdge AI opt-in app embed on your live Shopify theme. Each submission lands in Audience with its consent source recorded.

- **What counts as valid WhatsApp marketing opt-in?** A clear, affirmative action by the customer, with wording beside it that names WhatsApp marketing from your store specifically. A pre-ticked box, a buried line in your terms, or a list you bought do not count, and relying on them puts your business number at risk.
- **Why is my opt-in popup not showing on my Shopify store?** In order of likelihood: the tool is still a draft, the TopEdge AI app embed is not enabled on your live theme, an ad blocker is hiding it, or your display rules exclude the page you are testing on. Test in an incognito window with blockers off.
- **Do customers have to opt in again to receive order updates?** No. Order, shipping and delivery updates are transactional and send as Utility templates, which do not require marketing consent. Opt-in governs promotional broadcasts only, and opting out of marketing does not stop order updates.

### Run a shared WhatsApp inbox with your team

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/shared-inbox-handover · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Chats is your WhatsApp team inbox. Open a conversation there and press Reply myself; the bot pauses so only your team replies. Within 24 hours of the customer’s last message you can send free text, and after that you must pick an approved template. Press Mark as done or Give back to bot when you finish, and automation resumes on the next inbound message.

- **Why can I not send a free-form WhatsApp reply?** The customer has not messaged you in the last 24 hours, so the service window has closed. WhatsApp only allows approved templates outside that window. Once the customer replies to your template, free text works again for another 24 hours.
- **What happens to the bot when an agent takes over?** It pauses for that conversation only, and other conversations keep running their flows. It stays paused until someone presses Give back to bot or Mark as done, which is why a thread that seems permanently silent is usually still paused.
- **Can several agents work the same WhatsApp number?** Yes. That is the point of a shared inbox: one business number, many agents, with assignment so two people do not answer the same customer. Each reply is attributed to the agent who sent it.

### Build a WhatsApp welcome menu with Flow Builder

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/build-your-first-flow · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Open Flow Builder and start from the seeded welcome flow. Add a greeting with three or four buttons for your most common questions plus a live-chat handover, then test in the simulator and publish. Saving a draft changes nothing; publishing replaces the live graph from the next inbound message.

- **What is the difference between Flow Builder and Journeys?** Flow Builder handles inbound conversations, what the bot says when a customer messages you, including menus, FAQ answers and handover to an agent. Journeys handle outbound automation triggered by Shopify events such as an order being placed or a cart being abandoned.
- **How many buttons can a WhatsApp message have?** Three quick-reply buttons per message. If you need more options, use a list node instead, which presents up to ten rows behind a single tap and reads better than two stacked button messages.
- **Why does my flow still show the old menu after I edited it?** Because the live bot runs a snapshot frozen at publish time. Saving the canvas updates the draft only. Publish again to replace the live graph, which takes effect from the next inbound message.

### Train the AI to answer customer questions

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/train-your-ai-brain · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Add your own Gemini or OpenAI key and fill in store knowledge: shipping, returns, sizing and payment. Then create intents with five to ten phrases each, written the way customers actually type. Test each intent's confidence and activate it, because an inactive intent never matches.

- **Do I need my own OpenAI or Gemini key?** For AI-generated replies, yes. TopEdge AI uses your own key, so usage is billed to you by that provider and you keep control of which model answers your customers. Keyword-matched intents with fixed replies work without any key.
- **How many example phrases does an intent need?** Five to ten, taken from real customer messages rather than written by you. Phrases in your own phrasing score poorly because customers do not write like the person who built the store: expect Hinglish, abbreviations and no punctuation.
- **Should the AI handle refunds and complaints?** No. Route anything involving money, a complaint or a legal question to a human. A confidently wrong answer about a refund costs far more than the time it saved, and customers escalate it publicly.

### Segment Shopify customers for WhatsApp

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/segment-your-customers · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Build a segment in Audience → Customer groups by stacking conditions on order count, spend, tags, consent and recency, and watch the live matching count. Save it, then press Launch campaign to open the broadcast builder with that audience selected.

- **Are TopEdge AI segments dynamic or a fixed list?** Dynamic. A saved segment re-evaluates its conditions, so contacts move in and out as they order, lapse or change consent. You build a segment like "lapsed 90 days" once and it stays correct without any maintenance.
- **Why does my segment match zero customers?** Conditions combine with AND, so every rule has to be true at once. Two reasonable-looking rules, say, more than three orders and ordered in the last seven days, can easily describe nobody. Add conditions one at a time and watch the live count.

### Run digital warranty registration on WhatsApp

https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/warranty-registration · How-to guides · updated 2026-11-11

Create a warranty batch linking Shopify products to coverage dates, then share the public registration portal, where customers verify by WhatsApp OTP. Work claims through pending, approved, shipped or rejected. Each status change sends the customer a WhatsApp update automatically.

- **How do customers register a warranty?** They open your public registration portal, usually by scanning a QR on the packaging, select their product, enter their phone number and verify it with a WhatsApp OTP. The registration is then matched against the Shopify order where one exists.
- **Do customers need an account to claim?** No. Registration and claims both work from a mobile web page with WhatsApp OTP verification, so there is no password and no app to install. That is deliberate: every extra step loses registrations.

### Journeys reference: triggers, nodes, publishing

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/journeys · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

A journey sends messages on its own when something happens in your store. It has one trigger, the steps that follow, and a Live switch. Nothing sends until you press Publish.

- **Why is my published journey not sending?** Check in this order: the journey shows Live, each step’s template reads Approved, the conditions on the Entry step do not exclude the customer, and the customer has a phone number. The order’s activity list names the exact reason a message was skipped.
- **Do conditions combine with AND or OR?** Always AND. Every condition must be true for a customer to enter, which is why two reasonable conditions together can leave nobody.
- **How is revenue credited to a journey?** If a journey message was the last TopEdge AI message a customer got in the 7 days before ordering, that journey gets the credit. They do not need to tap the link.

### Flow Builder reference: nodes and publishing

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/flow-builder · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

A flow is what the bot says when a customer messages you: a greeting, menus, answers and a way to reach a person. Build it on a canvas, test it in the simulator, then press Publish.

- **How many flows can be live at once?** One flow answers new messages to your number. Others can be live too, as places a journey or another flow sends a customer.
- **Why will my flow not publish?** A step has a loose end. A buttons step with three buttons needs three lines out, even if two go to the same answer. Otherwise a customer could tap a button and get nothing.

### Chats reference: the shared WhatsApp inbox

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/live-chat · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Chats is your team’s WhatsApp inbox. Conversations are on the left, the chat in the middle and the customer’s orders on the right. Press Reply myself to pause the bot on one chat while you answer.

- **Why can I not type a message?** Either more than 24 hours have passed since the customer last wrote, so you need a template, or WhatsApp is disconnected. A Marketing template to someone who opted out is also blocked.
- **Does Reply myself stop the bot everywhere?** No, only on that chat. It stays paused until someone presses Give back to bot or Mark as done.

### Orders reference: status, activity, actions

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/orders · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Orders shows your Shopify orders with every WhatsApp message sent for each one. Open an order to see whether a message went out, and if not, why.

- **Why does an order say the message was skipped?** The activity list names the reason. Usually the template was not approved at that moment, the order had no phone number, the journey’s conditions left it out, or the message had already gone out.
- **Does changing a status here update Shopify?** Delivered and out for delivery are sent back to Shopify, and fulfilling creates a real Shopify fulfilment. If Shopify refuses, the status still changes in TopEdge AI.

### Audience reference: customers, segments, scores

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/audience-crm · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Your customer list lives under All customers. The Audience menu adds Customer groups (segments) and Customer scoring. Campaigns send to customer groups, so this is where you decide who gets marketing.

- **Why is a new opt-in missing from All customers?** Search the number with and without +91 and give it a minute or two. If it is still missing, check the opt-in tool is Live, not a draft.
- **Can I import a customer list?** Yes, as a CSV with Import. You confirm every contact agreed to hear from you, and that is recorded with the upload. Never import a bought or scraped list: messaging it gets your number blocked and reported.

### Campaigns reference: broadcasts and preflight

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/campaigns · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

A campaign is one message to a group you choose, sent now or at a set time. Each campaign uses one channel and one template. Before it sends, TopEdge AI checks consent and the template, and it sends in batches so your WhatsApp number stays healthy.

- **What is the difference between a campaign and a journey?** A campaign is one send you decide to make, to a group you choose. A journey sends on its own every time something happens in your store, for as long as it is live.
- **Can one campaign send on WhatsApp and email?** No, one channel each. Create two campaigns and keep the groups from overlapping, so nobody gets the same message twice.

### Email reference: Gmail sending and templates

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/email · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Connect your Gmail and TopEdge AI sends email from your own address. Use it for campaigns, or add a matching email to journey steps for customers you cannot reach on WhatsApp.

- **Does TopEdge AI send email from its own servers?** No. It sends through your connected Gmail, so emails come from your address and Gmail’s daily sending limits apply.
- **Why will my journey not publish with an email step?** Gmail is not connected. Connect it in Settings → Gmail, or remove the email step.

### Meta Manager reference: templates and catalog

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/meta-manager · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Meta Manager is where you create WhatsApp templates and send them to Meta for approval. QR codes, in the sidebar, makes codes that open a chat with you. Only Approved templates can be used in journeys and campaigns.

- **How long does template approval take?** Usually minutes, sometimes up to a day. Get templates approved before your launch day, not on it.
- **Why is my template list empty?** You are probably connected to a different WhatsApp Business Account from the one with your templates. Check the account in Settings → WhatsApp, then press Sync from Meta.
- **Why was my Utility template rejected?** Almost always a promotional word: sale, discount, offer, % off, free gift. Rewrite it as a plain order update, or submit it as Marketing.

### Opt-in tools reference: popups and widgets

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/opt-in-tools · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Opt-in tools are popups, spin wheels, mystery discounts and WhatsApp chat widgets for your store. Each one collects a phone number with consent. Make it live, then switch on the TopEdge AI app embed in your live Shopify theme.

- **Do I need to edit my Shopify theme?** No. You switch on an app embed in the theme editor. Nothing in your theme files changes, and turning it off removes it.
- **Which tool gets the most signups?** Spin wheels usually get the most. The WhatsApp widget gets the most interested shoppers, because they start the chat. Compare them on your own store with A/B test.

### AI and intents reference: knowledge and persona

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/ai-brain · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Two screens work together. AI & API key holds your AI provider key, the bot’s personality and the facts about your store. Intent, under Audience, teaches the bot to recognise what customers ask and decides what happens next.

- **Can I use the AI without an OpenAI or Gemini key?** Partly. Intents that match keywords and reply with fixed text work without a key. Answers written by the AI from your store facts need one.
- **Why does my intent match with low confidence?** Your example phrases are worded the way you write, not the way customers do. Paste five real messages from your inbox and the score goes up.

### Chat rules reference: routing and escalation

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/chat-rules · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Chat rules decide which teammate gets a conversation and when a chat moves from the bot to a person. Without them, every chat waits in one shared queue.

- **Why do I only see a Routing tab?** Smart rules are switched on workspace by workspace. Routing, assignment and handover all work without them.

### Analytics reference: revenue, team, delivery

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/analytics · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

The Reports menu has Analytics (revenue from your automations and campaigns), Product insights and Profit & loss. Revenue is credited to the last message a customer got within 7 days of ordering, so it will not match a clicks-only report.

- **Why is recovered revenue not what I expected?** An order counts if a reminder was the last message within 7 days, even if the customer came back without tapping. That is on purpose: on WhatsApp, many people act without tapping the link.
- **Why do the numbers not match Shopify?** Different measures. Shopify’s total sales include shipping and tax, while Profit & loss takes off product cost, shipping and fees. Compare the same dates and the same measure.

### Abandoned carts and website tracking reference

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/store-growth · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Website tracking records what shoppers do on your store. Abandoned carts lists the checkouts they left, with their phone numbers. Product insights (under Reports) and Stock (under Shopify suite) use the same data.

- **Why do my abandoned carts have no phone number?** The shopper left before typing one, or tracking is not capturing it. Adding to cart never gives a phone number. With a third-party checkout app, connect its webhook.
- **Does tracking slow down my store?** It loads through Shopify’s own app embed and pixel, separately from your theme. Nothing is written into your theme files.

### Shopify suite: products, profit and discount codes

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/commerce · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

The Shopify suite menu has Products, Stock, Warranty and Discount codes. Profit & loss, under Reports, shows what each order really earns once costs and returns are taken off.

- **Why is my margin lower than Shopify shows?** Profit & loss takes off costs Shopify does not know: product cost, shipping, payment fees and returns.
- **Do I need exact costs?** No. Estimates are much better than empty fields, which count every cost as zero. Start rough and adjust.

### Warranty hub reference: batches and claims

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/warranty-hub · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Warranty, under Shopify suite, lets customers register a product on WhatsApp. You group products into batches with a coverage period. Customers verify with a WhatsApp code, and every claim update is sent to them on WhatsApp.

- **Why can a customer not find their product?** It is not in any batch, the batch period does not cover the purchase date, or the product was added to Shopify after your last sync. Check the batch, then sync products.

### Settings reference: connections, team, billing

https://topedgeai.com/docs/reference/settings-billing · Reference · updated 2026-11-11

Settings has your workspace, billing and each connection: WhatsApp, Shopify, Gmail and WhatsApp shop. Brand identity sets the store name and policy links customers see.

- **Does cancelling an order give back my order allowance?** No. Orders count when they arrive. A COD order switched to prepaid is counted once, not twice.
- **Can I get GST invoices?** Yes, on every plan. Download them from Settings → Billing. Prices exclude GST, which is added at the applicable rate.

### The WhatsApp 24-hour service window

https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/whatsapp-service-window · WhatsApp rules · updated 2026-11-11

When a customer messages you, you can reply with anything for the next 24 hours. After that, only approved templates will send. Their next message opens a new 24 hours.

- **What is the WhatsApp 24-hour rule?** After a customer messages you, you can reply with anything for 24 hours. After that, only approved templates send, until the customer writes again.
- **Does sending a template restart the 24 hours?** No. Only a message from the customer does. If they reply to your template, even with a button tap, a new 24 hours starts.
- **Can I send a photo after 24 hours?** Only as part of an approved template with an image at the top. Once the customer replies, you can send photos freely again.

### WhatsApp message template categories and rules

https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/message-templates · WhatsApp rules · updated 2026-11-11

Utility templates are updates about something the customer did, like an order, and need no marketing consent. Marketing templates are anything promotional and need consent. Authentication is only for one-time codes. Meta has the final say on the category.

- **What is the difference between Utility and Marketing templates?** Utility templates are updates about something the customer already did, like an order, and need no marketing consent. Marketing templates are promotional and need consent. Meta sets the final category.
- **Why does Meta keep rejecting my template?** Most often a promotional word in a Utility template. Then: a variable at the very start or end, too little real text, or fake sample values. The reason is shown on the template row.
- **Can an approved template stop working?** Yes. Meta can pause or disable a template customers block or report. Journeys using it then skip sends, and the order’s activity list shows why.

### What WhatsApp automation actually costs

https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/conversation-pricing · WhatsApp rules · updated 2026-11-11

You pay two bills. TopEdge AI charges a subscription for the platform: in INR if you signed up on topedgeai.com, or in USD on your Shopify invoice if you installed from the Shopify App Store. Meta charges per message: in India ₹0.8631 for Marketing and ₹0.1150 for Utility, and service replies are free for the first 1,000 a month per number. TopEdge AI passes Meta’s charges through at 0% markup.

- **Does TopEdge AI add a markup to Meta’s charges?** No. Meta’s per-message charges pass through at 0% markup, so they are the same with any provider.
- **Why do I get two bills?** Two companies are involved. TopEdge AI bills for the platform: in INR through Razorpay if you signed up on topedgeai.com, or in USD through Shopify if you installed from the App Store. Meta bills per message, separately.
- **What is the cheapest way to cut messaging costs?** Keep anything that is not promotional as Utility, which costs far less than Marketing (₹0.1150 against ₹0.8631 per message in India), and send campaigns to customer groups instead of everyone.

### Plan limits, send caps and messaging tiers

https://topedgeai.com/docs/platform/limits-and-quotas · WhatsApp rules · updated 2026-11-11

Your TopEdge AI plan limits orders and campaign plus email sends per billing cycle. You are warned near the limit and stopped at it. Meta separately limits how many customers you can send templates to in 24 hours. Hitting either looks like "messages stopped sending".

- **How many WhatsApp messages can I send a day?** Meta limits how many different customers you can send templates to in 24 hours, based on your verification and quality rating. Your TopEdge AI plan separately limits campaign and email sends per billing cycle.
- **What happens when I reach my plan limit?** Sends stop; you are not charged extra. You are warned before, and limits reset at the start of each billing cycle.
- **How do I raise my WhatsApp limit?** Verify your business with Meta, send steady messages customers want, and keep them replying rather than blocking. The limit rises on its own.

### Troubleshooting WhatsApp automation

https://topedgeai.com/docs/troubleshooting · Help · updated 2026-11-11

Most problems are one of four things: a journey left in Draft, a template not Approved at send time, TopEdge AI not receiving your messages, or storefront tracking not capturing a phone. Check those first, and read the skip reason on the affected order; it usually names the cause.

- **Why is my WhatsApp automation not sending messages?** In order of likelihood: the journey is still in Draft rather than Published, the template it uses is not Approved at send time, trigger filters are excluding the customer, or the order has no phone number. The activity list on the affected order records a skip reason naming the actual cause.
- **Why is my WhatsApp inbox empty?** Almost always because TopEdge AI isn't subscribed to your messages. Reconnect from Settings → WhatsApp to fix it. Sending works without it but nothing inbound arrives. Check the Webhook tab in WhatsApp settings, and test by messaging your business number from a personal phone.
- **Who do I contact for help with TopEdge AI?** Use the contact page on this site. Include your store domain, what you expected, what actually happened, a screenshot of any banner, and the order number if it’s about a specific order. That usually gets a fix in one reply.

### TopEdge AI vs Getgabs

## Playbooks

### RTO in Ecommerce: Meaning, Full Form and Cost

https://topedgeai.com/blog/rto-meaning-ecommerce · published 2026-11-15 · updated 2026-11-15 · by Moksh Patel

RTO in ecommerce means Return to Origin : an undelivered or refused parcel travels back to the seller. On a Cash on Delivery order you collect nothing and still pay both shipping legs: ₹180 to ₹240 in direct logistics per parcel, or ₹450 to ₹900 once the ad spend behind the order is counted.

- **What is the full form of RTO in ecommerce?** RTO stands for Return to Origin. It is the courier status for a parcel that could not be delivered, or was refused, and is being sent back to the seller. It is not the Regional Transport Office, which is the same three letters in a different context.
- **What is the difference between RTO and NDR?** An NDR (Non-Delivery Report) is raised when one delivery attempt fails, and the order can still be saved. An RTO is what an unresolved NDR becomes: the parcel is on its way back. Amazon Shipping India states that nearly every failed delivery not resolved within 36 hours of the NDR ends in cancellation and RTO.
- **How much does one RTO cost a seller in India?** ₹180 to ₹240 in direct logistics per parcel, per Amazon Shipping India: forward shipping, the return leg, repackaging and inventory held in transit. Counting the ad spend that won the order, ClickPost puts the fully loaded loss at ₹450 to ₹900 per RTO order, via First Resort. Both were read on 21 October 2026.
- **What is a normal RTO rate in India?** It depends on payment mode and season. Unicommerce puts national RTO at 39.2% at the November 2025 festive peak and 21.0% by March 2026 among brands that verify orders before dispatch. GoKwik, via First Resort, reports COD RTO near 26% against under 2% for prepaid.
- **Who pays for RTO, the seller or the courier?** The seller. Amazon Shipping India’s breakdown counts the non-refundable forward shipping and the reverse leg as the seller’s loss, along with repackaging and inventory held in transit. On a COD order the seller also collects nothing, because the buyer never paid.

### Add a WhatsApp Chat Button to Shopify (3 Ways)

https://topedgeai.com/blog/add-whatsapp-chat-button-shopify · published 2026-11-15 · updated 2026-11-15 · by Moksh Patel

To add a WhatsApp chat button to Shopify for free, make a wa.me link in our WhatsApp link generator , copy the button code, and paste it just before /body in your theme’s theme.liquid file. If you also want to capture the shopper’s number with consent, use an app widget instead.

- **How do I add a WhatsApp button to my Shopify store for free?** Make a wa.me link with our free WhatsApp link generator, copy the button code it gives you, and paste it just before the closing </body> tag in your theme.liquid file. Save, and a green chat button sits in the bottom-right corner of every page. No app and no monthly fee.
- **Can I use the same WhatsApp button on a website that is not on Shopify?** Yes. The button is a plain HTML link with an inline icon, so it works on any website whose template you can edit. Paste it before the closing </body> tag of your site’s main layout file.
- **Will a WhatsApp chat button slow down my Shopify store?** The code button will not: it loads no script and no external file. An app widget does load a script, which is what lets it capture a number or run triggers. Shopify’s theme performance guidance advises finding and deferring app scripts that block the page, so check your speed after installing any widget.
- **Does the WhatsApp chat button work on desktop?** Yes. WhatsApp’s help page states that click to chat works on both your phone and WhatsApp Web. On a computer the link opens WhatsApp Web or the desktop app, with your pre-filled message in the chat box.
- **Where do chats from the button arrive?** On whichever number the link points to. If that number is on the WhatsApp Business app, chats arrive on that phone. If it is connected to a WhatsApp Business Platform tool such as TopEdge AI, they land in a shared inbox where several people can reply, with the Shopify order shown beside the chat.

- **What does AiSensy charge per WhatsApp message in India?** For Indian numbers AiSensy lists ₹1.09 per marketing message and ₹0.145 per utility, authentication and service message, effective 1 October 2026. The first 1,000 service messages a month are free. Meta’s own India rates are ₹0.8631 and ₹0.1150, so AiSensy is about 26% above Meta on every paid category.
- **Does AiSensy add a markup to Meta’s WhatsApp rates?** Yes. AiSensy’s published rates sit about 26% above Meta’s India card on marketing, utility, authentication and service messages, and they are the same on every paid plan. Every 1,000 marketing messages cost ₹226.90 more than at Meta’s rate, and every 1,000 utility messages ₹30 more.
- **How much does an extra agent cost on AiSensy?** Extra agent seats are ₹750 a seat a month, read on 12 November 2026. Basic includes one owner and five agents, Premium includes one owner and nine agents, and Unlimited allows up to 200 agents.
- **Is AiSensy cheaper on yearly billing?** Yes, by 10%. Read on 12 November 2026, Basic is ₹1,500 a month billed monthly, ₹1,425 billed quarterly and ₹1,350 billed yearly; Pro is ₹3,200, ₹3,040 and ₹2,880; Premium is ₹9,100, ₹8,645 and ₹8,190. - **What are AiSensy’s pricing plans?** AiSensy has five plans, read 12 November 2026: Free Forever at ₹0, Basic ₹1,500, Pro ₹3,200, Premium ₹9,100 and Unlimited ₹45,000 a month on monthly billing. Basic includes broadcasting, the shared inbox and the Shopify integration; Pro adds the campaign scheduler and click tracking; Premium adds 250 messages a second and downloadable reports. Chatbot Flows (₹2,500 a month) and the AI Chat Agent (₹1,350 a month) are sold separately on any plan.
- **Is AiSensy cheaper than WATI?** On the plan price and on our worked bill, yes; per marketing message, no. AiSensy Basic is ₹1,500 a month (read 12 November 2026) against ₹2,999 for WATI Growth (read 10 November 2026), and at 500 orders a month with the same message mix the bills come to about ₹12,908 and ₹14,325 before taxes. But AiSensy charges ₹1.09 per marketing message against ₹1.0357 on WATI Growth, so a store that sends mostly campaigns keeps less of the saving.
